\tablenote{Denominator: all 63 trade-completed group episodes, classified by the turn-ending decision of the owner's first actual management turn (whole window). This is a different population from T9/F4, which condition on the 42 groups buildable at entry (34 built; 3 defaults, 3 received conflicts, 2 stated holds). The two splits differ by exactly the three later-buildable groups that were not built: G13 Opus light blue (default after refusal), G13 Grok yellow (received conflict) and G14 Gemini yellow (valid END); the nine never-legal groups have no counterpart in T9. Engine defaults = default after refusal + other default (4 = T9's 3 + G13 Opus). Classes describe records, not willingness or lost executable builds. Source: fable/exhibits/first\_management\_causes.csv (per-group detail in the paired JSON); Sol's peer\_followup\_checks.json recounts the derived rows.}
